description: Expected verdicts for the three synthetic lockfiles. A package-lock.json carries no timestamp, so the install time is supplied separately (in the product, from the file's mtime or from the user); the tests pass it explicitly.

lockfiles.why: resolved flux-core@1.0.1, a compromised version, and installed inside the live window
resolved flux-core@1.0.0, which was never compromised; install predates the window
resolved flux-core@1.0.2, the fixed version published after the window closed

verdict_meanings.EXPOSED: a resolved version is itself a compromised artifact
verdict_meanings.AT_RISK: the resolved version is clean, but the package transitively depends on a compromised package
verdict_meanings.CLEAN: neither the version nor its dependency closure touches a compromised artifact
